{{Quote|There's nothing to worry about. I have an alibi. Like all sensible Heads of State, I have a double, hard at work pretending to be me back at my quarters.|Jagged Fel, referring to Valanti|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Karn Valanti''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a double for [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]. In [[43 ABY]], he traveled with Fel to the [[Unification Summit]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|one of Fel's missions]] with [[Darkmeld]]&mdash;a secret pro-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] organization&mdash;Valanti covered for Fel at the Imperial Embassy so he would not be missed. Later, Valanti dined with [[Lina Zev]]&mdash;a double of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]&mdash;at the restaurant [[Indigo Tower]] in order to draw [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] away from Fel and Solo. After Fel and Solo were [[Wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo|married]] in [[44 ABY]], Valanti and Zev again posed as the two on the planet [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Oh yum&hellip;Vagnerian canapés. Mom loves these. Have you ever had one?"''<br />''"No. Mmm&hellip;okay. They're pretty amazing.|Lina Zev and Karn Valanti, roleplaying as Jaina Solo and Jagged Fel|<ref name="Omen" />}}
[[File:Jagged_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Jagged Fel, who Valanti served as his double. ]]
Karn Valanti was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] who worked for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] government around [[43 ABY]]. He often served as a double for the Imperial [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Jagged Fel]]. Valanti accompanied Fel as part of the Imperial Remnant delegation to the [[Unification Summit]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the Summit, Fel joined [[Darkmeld]], a secret organization created by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to counter [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies. During one of Darkmeld's missions, in which they [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|captured]] the [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Seff Hellin]], Valanti took up Fel's place at the Imperial Embassy, so the Head of State would not be missed.<ref name="Outcast" />

Shortly after, Valanti officially joined Darkmeld, taking on the codename of "Carved." Meanwhile, reporters and [[Journalist/Legends|journalists]] had begun following Fel and Solo&mdash;who were in a relationship&mdash;wherever they went, making it difficult for the two to have an evening alone together. During a mission deemed Operation [[Caranak/Legends|Caranak]], Valanti partnered up with a double of Solo, [[Lina Zev]], and the two dined together at the restaurant [[Indigo Tower]] to throw off anyone who might be following Fel and Solo. One such journalist, [[Javis Tyrr]], fell for the ploy and dined at the restaurant, hoping to raise the ratings of [[Javis Tyrr Presents: The Jedi Among Us|his show]] by exposing information about Fel and Solo's relationship. He eventually discovered that Valanti and Zev were simply doubles, but by that time Fel and Solo were on their way to an inn halfway around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], free to dine alone.<ref name="Omen" /> Valanti and Zev again masqueraded as the two on the planet [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], making occasional public appearances while the real Fel and Solo&mdash;who had recently been [[Wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo|married]]&mdash;embarked on a secret [[Skirmish on Sakuub|trip]] to the planet [[Sakuub]].<ref name="Get">{{InsiderCite|134|Getaway}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As Jagged Fel's double, Karn Valanti was very similar in appearance to the Head of State, with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. Valanti also studied Fel's movements, and was able to imitate them perfectly. His voice, however, was somewhat deeper and more nasal than Fel's.<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karn Valanti first appeared in author [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2009]] debut ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Omen" /> Valanti had previously been alluded to in the first novel of the series, [[Aaron Allston]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''.<ref name="Outcast" /> Valanti was later mentioned in a short story by Golden, ''[[Getaway]]'', released in [[Star Wars Insider 134|issue 134]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine in [[2012]]. In the story, Valanti's surname was misspelled "Valenti."<ref name="Get" />
